title: Procedural 3d End To End

summary: Procedural 3d (generation3d) works end to end from a user perspective in the React playground and the wgpu renderer: every window renders (Flow with a painted node graph, Preview with status/progress/cancel, Generations/Form/Generate preview, Viewer preview), all 8 examples load with live 3d preview (hex column converges in ~12 s, was never), hover/selection/orbit round-trip, role and mode switching by click and keyboard. Root causes fixed: missing extension invoke door on both sides, contributions push starvation, tick storms, a :root CSS animation style-recalc storm (10 s per hop), example-switch livelock, un-budgeted boolean evaluate killing the worker, view-state carriage over the 64 KiB cap, node-graph paint/camera/captions, mesh delivery round trips, close ladder 2052→125 turns, wgpu dock/reconcile/witness/framing/settle. Dev tooling: vite watcher wedge, one plugin-module staging root, wasm-dev opt-level overrides. See 📓️summary-2026-09-12.md and the 📓️*-2026-09-12.md lane reports.
